Agent","expert_mode":false}],"id":"ca11fffacae54ce788e5090aff1fb594","goal_id":"primary","expert_mode":false},{"type":"ScriptedAction","script":"(function execute() {

 try {
 var tableName = 'dmn_demand';
 var userId = gs.getUserID();
 var userName = gs.getUserDisplayName();

 var total = 0;
 var active = 0;
 var mine = 0;
 var high = 0;
 var triage = 0;
 var stale = 0;

 var check = new GlideRecord(tableName);
 if (!check.isValid()) {
 vaVars.raw_demand_data = '';
 // vaVars.demand_numbers_output = 'Demand table dmn_demand is not available.';
 return;
 }

 var gaTotal = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaTotal.addAggregate('COUNT');
 gaTotal.query();
 if (gaTotal.next()) {
 total = gaTotal.getAggregate('COUNT');
 }

 var gaActive = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaActive.addAggregate('COUNT');
 if (gaActive.isValidField('active')) {
 gaActive.addQuery('active', true);
 }
 gaActive.query();
 if (gaActive.next()) {
 active = gaActive.getAggregate('COUNT');
 }

 var gaMine = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaMine.addAggregate('COUNT');

 if (gaMine.isValidField('demand_manager') && gaMine.isValidField('assigned_to')) {
 var qMine = gaMine.addQuery('demand_manager', userId);
 qMine.addOrCondition('assigned_to', userId);
 } else if (gaMine.isValidField('demand_manager')) {
 gaMine.addQuery('demand_manager', userId);
 } else if (gaMine.isValidField('assigned_to')) {
 gaMine.addQuery('assigned_to', userId);
 }

 if (gaMine.isValidField('active')) {
 gaMine.addQuery('active', true);
 }

 gaMine.query();
 if (gaMine.next()) {
 mine = gaMine.getAggregate('COUNT');
 }

 var gaHigh = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaHigh.addAggregate('COUNT');
 if (gaHigh.isValidField('priority')) {
 gaHigh.addQuery('priority', 'IN', '1,2');
 }
 if (gaHigh.isValidField('active')) {
 gaHigh.addQuery('active', true);
 }
 gaHigh.query();
 if (gaHigh.next()) {
 high = gaHigh.getAggregate('COUNT');
 }

 var gaTriage = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaTriage.addAggregate('COUNT');
 if (gaTriage.isValidField('active')) {
 gaTriage.addQuery('active', true);
 }
 if (gaTriage.isValidField('demand_manager')) {
 gaTriage.addNullQuery('demand_manager');
 } else if (gaTriage.isValidField('assigned_to')) {
 gaTriage.addNullQuery('assigned_to');
 }
 gaTriage.query();
 if (gaTriage.next()) {
 triage = gaTriage.getAggregate('COUNT');
 }

 var staleDate = new GlideDateTime();
 staleDate.addDaysUTC(-14);

 var gaStale = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaStale.addAggregate('COUNT');
 gaStale.addQuery('sys_updated_on', '<=', staleDate);
 if (gaStale.isValidField('active')) {
 gaStale.addQuery('active', true);
 }
 gaStale.query();
 if (gaStale.next()) {
 stale = gaStale.getAggregate('COUNT');
 }

 var stateData = '';
 var gaState = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaState.addAggregate('COUNT');
 if (gaState.isValidField('state')) {
 gaState.groupBy('state');
 gaState.orderBy('state');
 gaState.query();

 while (gaState.next()) {
 stateData += gaState.getDisplayValue('state') + ': ' +
 gaState.getAggregate('COUNT') + '\n';
 }
 } else {
 stateData = 'State field not available.\n';
 }

 var priorityData = '';
 var gaPriority = new GlideAggregate(tableName);
 gaPriority.addAggregate('COUNT');
 if (gaPriority.isValidField('priority')) {
 gaPriority.groupBy('priority');
 gaPriority.orderBy('priority');
 gaPriority.query();

 while (gaPriority.next()) {
 priorityData += gaPriority.getDisplayValue('priority') + ': ' +
 gaPriority.getAggregate('COUNT') + '\n';
 }
 } else {
 priorityData = 'Priority field not available.\n';
 }

 var raw = '';
 raw += 'Demand Manager: ' + userName + '\n\n';
 raw += 'Total Demands: ' + total + '\n';
 raw += 'Active Demands: ' + active + '\n';
 raw += 'Demands Assigned To Me: ' + mine + '\n';
 raw += 'High Priority Demands: ' + high + '\n';
 raw += 'Demands Needing Triage: ' + triage + '\n';
 raw += 'Stale Demands Not Updated In Last 14 Days: ' + stale + '\n\n';

 raw += 'State Counts:\n' + stateData + '\n';
 raw += 'Priority Counts:\n' + priorityData + '\n';

 vaVars.raw_demand_data = raw;

 } catch (ex) {
